GETAWAY / DOCS

THE DRIVER’S
HANDBOOK.

Pick up the crew. Drop them somewhere safe. Make it back to the garage with your haul.

GETAWAY is a browser driving game with shared online neighborhoods and personal arcade shifts. Your first visit starts outside, where Jules welcomes you to the city and walks you toward your apartment. Follow the gold markers and open the front door to collect your keys. The five-minute shift timer begins when you leave for the car. Deliveries add time and credits, while riskier pickups bring more attention from the police.

YOUR HAUL ISN’T SAFE YET

Credits from a run are unbanked until you stop at Last Exit Garage and bank them. Getting caught, wrecking your car, or running out of time ends the run and loses the unbanked haul.

01

YOUR FIRST RUN

  1. Meet Jules outside your new apartment. Choose Let’s go, or press E or Enter to continue the greeting.
  2. Walk toward the green awning using W A S D, arrows, floor clicks, or the touch direction buttons. Walk to the front door follows the clear path for you.
  3. At the gold marker, press E or choose Open your front door. Your move-in saves to your account and you enter the apartment.
  4. Open your first-chapter journal and choose a free Workhorse finish in the garage.
  5. Complete three connected jobs: Jules’s supper delivery, Mina’s seedlings, and Rae’s workshop visit. Follow the driving route, open each destination, finish the marked task, and speak to your passenger inside.
  6. Bring your haul to Last Exit Garage and bank it. Claim the housewarming kit, customize your home or car, then create a home-tour invitation.

Your journal tracks the chapter and saves it to your account. Returning players start at home. Choose Replay your arrival · Meet Jules in the journal to repeat the welcome walk without resetting progress. The bedroom laptop and front door also let you start a personal arcade shift.

YOUR APARTMENT

Your apartment now has roughly twice the original floor space, with a longer fitted kitchen, a four-seat dining area, a spacious lounge, a larger bedroom, bathroom, and entry hall. The wider doorways and aisles connect every room. The close camera follows your character by default. Use + / − or the mouse wheel to zoom, the Floor Plan button for the overhead view, and the full-screen button to fill your display on supported browsers. Click furniture or choose an item in Phone → Home to walk over and use it. Sit on the sofa to watch the animated TV channel, make coffee, take a shower, or rest in bed. Coffee, showers, and rest finish after a few seconds. Press E or move to stop an activity. Completed home activities and the TV setting save in this browser. The bedroom laptop has your briefing. The wardrobe opens your cars, skins, and drivers. Resting in bed saves progress, including your position beside the bed. The entry door starts a shift or resumes the one you saved. No shift time passes while you are home.

02 / PHONE

YOUR IN-GAME PHONE

Press P or tap the phone button to open your phone at home or while driving. Your shift and apartment activities pause while you browse. Press P, Esc, or the close button to put it away.

  • Quests: follow the six-step first-night guide and four career or home milestones. Track a quest to save your selection. Go to objective sets a driving route or walks your character to the right place at home. Milestones track progress; fares provide the credit payouts.
  • Dispatch: view current fares, risk, destinations, and occupied seats. Choose a pickup or passenger drop-off to set your route.
  • People: meet twelve regulars, read their backgrounds, and continue their stories by completing ride goals.
  • City map: see your car, pickups, drop-offs, garage, and current route. Route to Last Exit when you are ready to bank.
  • Garage: inspect and equip actual car models, skins, and drivers. Credit unlocks and demo burn reviews work inside the phone. Changing cars during a shift applies to your next shift.
  • Home: choose furniture and your character walks over to use it. During a shift, save and return home first.
  • My stats: check banked credits, best haul, finished shifts, deliveries, collection progress, and the current or saved shift.
  • Settings: change sound and camera, save progress, recover the car, restart the shift, or return home.
  • Guide: read the controls and game rules.

Your tracked quest and existing progress save in this browser. A suspended shift keeps its passengers, haul, timer, and selected route.

CAMERA VIEWS

SEE IT FROM THE DRIVER'S SEAT.

Press C or tap the camera button to switch views. In the car, cycle through chase, first person, and high view. While walking, switch between first and third person. The apartment's Floor Plan button still opens the overhead room view.

In first person, drag across the game scene to look around. Use WASD to walk relative to where you are looking; A and D step sideways. On the keyboard, left/right arrows turn and Page Up/Page Down look up or down. On touch devices, hold the movement buttons with one thumb and drag the scene with the other. Tap an object or use E nearby to interact.

The driver-eye camera follows the car's direction. Drag to glance sideways while the usual driving controls steer the car. These vehicles use an unobstructed driver-eye view without a modeled dashboard. Walking and driving camera choices save separately in this browser.

ON A PHONE

At home or in the garage, use the direction buttons to walk and the action button to interact. In the car, hold the steering and gas buttons together. Brake slows the car before reversing. Drift and nitro have their own buttons, and the on-screen pause button opens the menu.

Nitro refills when you release it. If you get stuck, use Recover car in the pause menu. Recovery moves you to a nearby road; it doesn’t clear your wanted level.

03

PEOPLE & RIDES

Twelve regulars have stories to share, with 16 pickup spots and 26 drop-off locations across the city. Open Phone → Dispatch to see who needs a ride, their destination, request, and base fare. Open People to read their background and follow their three story chapters.

Jules is a night cook saving for a food truck. Mina is restoring a city garden. Theo is trying to reach his first real show. Elias has a copied ledger and a police tail. Each passenger has a different character model, dialogue, and reason to travel.

Ride requestGoalGoal bonus
Smooth rideFinish at 80% comfort or higher350 CR
Precious cargoNo collisions; at least 85% cargo intact450 CR
Against the clockArrive before the passenger deadline500 CR
A little adrenalineUse 4 seconds of nitro; at most 1 collision450 CR
Lose the tailLose your wanted level before drop-off650 CR

Base fares are 850, 1,450, or 2,100 CR, multiplied by your delivery streak. Careful driving can add a tip of up to 20% of that fare. Goal bonuses are separate. Tips and goal bonuses require a driven trip of at least 12 metres and two seconds.

Missing a deadline or damaging cargo loses the goal bonus, but you can still finish the ride for its fare. A passenger who needs a discreet arrival stays in the car until you lose the police. Ordinary passengers do not create police heat; Dispatch marks rides that do.

Stop in the pickup ring and your passenger walks over to board. At the destination, stop to begin a visit. Open the entrance, complete the marked task, then speak with your passenger. Mission Success shows the fare, tip, ride-goal bonus, rating, and time added to your shift. Meeting their goal advances a story chapter; every completed trip is remembered in People.

A pickup adds 10 seconds to your shift. A completed ride adds 40 seconds, up to 360 seconds remaining. Each completed ride increases your streak multiplier by 0.25, up to ×3. Fares, tips, and bonuses remain unbanked until you return to Last Exit.

Opening the phone pauses both your shift and passenger deadlines. Saved shifts preserve their current comfort, cargo, boost progress, and remaining deadline. Your car’s seat count limits how many passengers you can carry at once.

03 / DESTINATIONS

GO INSIDE. FINISH THE HANDOFF.

Passenger quests continue beyond the curb. All 22 destinations open into one of four places: a furnished apartment, a working garage, a garden conservatory, or a music venue or café. Each visit uses the passenger’s story, destination name, and a specific handoff, from delivering Mina’s cuttings to collecting Ivo’s repair part.

  1. Stop on the ground inside the blue destination ring. Discreet passengers need a clean arrival without police.
  2. Walk to the entrance and press E or tap the action button. Front doors slide open; garage shutters lift.
  3. Walk inside and complete the marked task. Use WASD, arrows, floor clicks, or touch controls. Walk to objective follows a clear route for you.
  4. Speak with your passenger to complete the quest. Mission Success shows your earnings and whether the ride goal advanced their story.
  5. Choose Continue shift to return to your parked car. The fare stays in your unbanked haul until you return to Last Exit.

The shift clock, pursuit, and every passenger’s ride timer pause during visits. Back to car or Escape leaves an unfinished quest without a reward; press E or tap Enter destination to return. Other passengers stay aboard. Saves retain an unfinished passenger and the parked car; after reloading, the visit starts again at the entrance. Completed fares are saved immediately and cannot be collected again.

Open Phone → Quests during your shift to see the destination quests for passengers on board and route to one.

04

POLICE & PURSUIT

The stars show how much attention you’ve attracted. Riskier jobs bring more heat. Police chase your car, and roadblocks can appear as a run gets more dangerous.

Break their line of sight using city blocks and shortcuts. Watch the escape meter while officers search your last known position. Avoid getting boxed in: the bust meter fills when police keep you trapped.

Drift to take a tight corner, then straighten up before using nitro. Your integrity meter shows how much damage your car can still take.

05

GARAGE & UPGRADES

TEST ANY CAR FOR FREE

Walk into the apartment garage, select a car, and choose Test Drive. All six rides are available to try, including locked cars, before reading the laptop briefing. The city has no shift countdown during a test drive. Use Return to Garage to try another car, or stop at Last Exit and press E. Your saved shift, credits, and token balance stay intact. Test drives do not unlock cars or earn fares.

Press G or choose Garage at home to walk to the lift. Downstairs, use WASD, arrows, or click the floor to walk around your cars and workshop. Approach the display and press E to inspect six rides, rotate them, and choose a car. Walk around returns to walking. Walk to the lift to go upstairs, or the City Exit to drive out. The wardrobe also opens your collection of rides, car skins, and drivers. The original cars use banked credits; special rides and cosmetics have a burn-to-unlock preview.

The Workhorse carries more passengers and takes more damage. Night Runner balances pace and capacity. Redline is the quickest ride, with room for one passenger. Alley Cat turns quickly in tight streets. Night Cab carries four passengers. Ironhide has the most integrity. Car skins change appearance without changing these stats.

Every playable ride uses detailed concept bodywork. Workhorse is a utility crossover, Night Cab adds a taxi roof sign, and the street traffic uses lighter versions of the same designs. Paint skins work across the full garage. The four new model downloads keep your existing unlocks and driving stats.

Banking ends your current shift and lets you return to your apartment. Your banked credits and best run appear at home. A car selected while a shift is saved applies to your next new shift; resuming keeps the original car.

YOUR FIRST CHAPTER

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME.

Open your journal inside the apartment. Collect your keys, choose a free Workhorse finish, then meet three neighbors: Jules at the diner, Mina at Night Market, and Rae at Roadhouse. Follow each route, enter the destination, complete the handoff, and speak to your passenger.

After all three jobs, bank your haul at Last Exit and claim the housewarming kit. Customize your room palette, flooring, rug, wall art, lighting, garage floor, car paint, and wheels. The kit adds planters and underglow. Preview changes, then save your design or cancel.

Your chapter and design are saved to your signed-in account. An unfinished driving shift and arcade credits remain on this browser. Home-tour links show your saved apartment and garage; you can close old invitations from the journal. Visitors need access to this Site. Home tours are personal; shared driving happens in online neighborhoods.

WALLET

CONNECT YOUR WALLET

Choose Connect Wallet in the website header, select a detected wallet, and approve the connection in your wallet. The button then shows your address. Open it again to copy your address, see the active network, or disconnect from GETAWAY.

Use an Ethereum-compatible browser wallet such as MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Rabby, or Brave Wallet. If your browser has no wallet extension, open the site in your mobile wallet’s browser. The connection panel includes a site-link copy button.

GETAWAY remembers your chosen wallet on this browser and checks its current permission when you return. Connecting only shares your public address; it does not sign a message, approve tokens, or send a transaction. Your game profile and Crew still use your Site account. Use the testnet workshop to deploy or import the test contracts. Mainnet burns remain disabled.

05 / COLLECTION

SKINS & BURN UNLOCKS

BURN PREVIEW — NO REAL TOKENS

Your collection starts with 25,000 demo tokens. They have no cash value. Demo burns never open a wallet or send a blockchain transaction. Demo ownership saves on this device and does not become a live wallet entitlement.

  1. Walk to the garage lift in your apartment, or use the Garage button (G). Walk around the garage, approach the display, and press E to browse six rides. Drag to rotate the display car and review a burn to acquire it. The wardrobe also opens your collection.
  2. Choose Rides, Car skins, or Drivers. Select a card to inspect its actual game model.
  3. Choose Burn demo tokens. Review the cost, balance, and item before confirming.
  4. The item unlocks and equips immediately. Drivers appear in your apartment; car skins apply to your ride. New cars are used on the next fresh shift.
ItemTypePreview cost

THE FUTURE GETAWAY TOKEN

A future GETAWAY launch through Pons on Robinhood Chain is planned. Real burns require that new GETAWAY token and a deployed unlock contract. The existing PONS token is not used for skin purchases. The wallet flow reads the price from the contract, requests an exact token approval, and then requests the burn. The contract checks that the token supply and your balance both fell by the required amount before it grants the item. Ownership belongs to the connected wallet; these unlocks are not transferable NFTs.

Robinhood Chain testnet burns are available after you set up a verified shop. Test tokens have no monetary value. Mainnet burns remain disabled; testnet ownership does not promise future mainnet items. Preview prices can change before launch. Your original driver, factory paint, and credit-based cars remain available without token burns.

06

LEARN THE STREETS

DOWNTOWN

Union Trust and The Regent sit on the north road. The market is to the northeast. Main streets connect through a compact grid.

NEON ROW

The records store and arcade line the center alley. Motel 86 sits to the west and the Grand Hotel to the east. Watch for the alley ramp.

LAST EXIT

The garage is on the southeast road. The 24-hour diner is nearby. The west-side pawn shop and laundromat hide another ramp shortcut.

BEYOND DOWNTOWN

Head north to Central Station and Starlight Cinema. The west road reaches Port Authority and Pier Market. Riverside Park and North Gardens bring green space to the outer districts. Follow the southern road to the motor yards and Roadhouse.

The city now has 13 districts and 484 junctions across nearly twice the area of the nine-district map. Explore the expanded city with shopfronts, awnings, masonry, rooftop equipment, gardens, and loading yards. Hundreds of pedestrians walk the sidewalks across the city. Press M for the full atlas: zoom, pan, choose a district or job, or click a road to set a waypoint. Your minimap follows the streets around your car. After completing all three story chapters with a passenger, repeat trips can take you to the outer districts.

EXPLORE THE CITY ↗

Look for grass lawns, flower beds, and gravel paths in the parks and residential streets. Planted strips edge the shops, while weeds, utility covers, and repaired asphalt add detail around the industrial blocks.

PLAYER GUIDE / EVERYDAY LIFE

FIND YOUR OWN RHYTHM.

Move in, take a drive, help the neighborhood, and make something for your place. You can play without a wallet. Your Site account saves neighborhood progress; a wallet is only needed for the optional testnet collection.

YOUR FIRST EVENING

  1. Meet Jules and follow the welcome walk to your apartment. Collect your keys and choose your free starter car.
  2. Finish the three journal missions and claim your housewarming kit. Choose a room finish and car paint.
  3. Press O, choose a player name and join a numbered neighborhood. Friends must join that same server and have access to this Site.
  4. Press N → Explore. Pick a daily errand and follow its GPS route. At the stop, reopen Explore, help for four seconds, and finish to collect materials and home credits.
  5. Make a furnishing from a workshop recipe. Open My home, choose the item, place it on a free tile, rotate it and save.
  6. Press M → Casino → Last Hand Casino → Set GPS Route. Look for the green-and-gold building across the street from Last Exit Garage. Stop at its red-carpet entrance and press E to meet your friends for cards. Or open your apartment to accepted friends from the Friends tab.

DAILY ERRANDS & MATERIALS

WhereHelp withBring home
Community gardenTidy the planting beds3 wood + 20 home credits
Rae’s workshopSort reusable parts3 scrap + 20 home credits
Night marketFold spare canvas3 fabric + 20 home credits

Each errand can be completed once per account per UTC day. Materials stay in your account until you use them. A Neighborhood planter needs 3 wood and 1 scrap; a Reclaimed lounge chair needs 3 wood and 3 fabric. Each recipe adds one unique furnishing to your collection. Materials and crafted furniture cannot be traded.

MORE TO WORK TOWARD

City jobs build courier, mechanic or racer reputation. Crew jobs reward everyone who completes the route together. Weekly events add a longer goal and a display trophy. Use your earnings for furniture, home expansions, car styling and emotes.

KNOW YOUR BALANCES

Home credits buy neighborhood upgrades. Arcade credits come from solo shifts. Free club chips are only for cards. Demo tokens are a local preview, while tGETAWAY is an optional testnet token. These balances have no cash-out feature and cannot be exchanged with each other.

LAST HAND / SOCIAL CLUB

STAY FOR ONE MORE HAND.

Last Hand is a shared place to walk around, chat, use emotes and play cards. Join a neighborhood, then press N → Explore → Set route to Last Hand. You can also search Last Hand on the M map. Stop outside its sign and press E or the entrance button.

Inside, use WASD, click the floor or use the touch arrows. The table buttons guide you to Clover or Diamond. Walk close and press E to open the table. Friends on your numbered server see the same room and tables. Chat & Emotes opens room chat, where you can mute players or report messages.

BLACKJACK WITH FRIENDS

  1. Take one of four seats. You start with 500 free play chips.
  2. Choose Play to put in 10 chips. Wait for your friends to ready up, then Deal ready players.
  3. Choose Hit for another card or Stand to keep your hand. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
  4. When everyone finishes, the dealer reveals the hidden card and draws to 17. Aces count as 1 or 11; picture cards count as 10.
  5. Wins return 20 chips including your stake; ties return 10. All wins pay 1:1, including a two-card 21. No splitting, doubling or insurance.

Hands have a 60-second limit. Unfinished hands stand automatically when time runs out or a player leaves the room. Unplayed ready stakes are returned when you leave your seat or your connection expires. Your chip balance stays saved when you reconnect; a disconnected hand stands at the next table update. Once per UTC day, Daily top-up raises a balance below 500 back to 500. Your first 500 chips count as that day’s top-up.

JUST HERE TO HANG OUT

You do not need to play cards to use the lounge. Club chips cannot be purchased, transferred, cashed out or exchanged for GETAWAY or collectible rewards. The club never requests a wallet transaction.

GETAWAY SOCIAL

YOUR CREW & YOUR ADDRESS.

Open Crew to create your profile and add friends. In the game, choose ONLINE / HOMES or press O to join a shared neighborhood. You can create your player name there too.

  1. Add a friend. Share the 12-character code on your player card. Enter a friend's code to send a request. They must have access to this Site and create a Crew profile.
  2. Accept the request. The Requests tab shows received and sent requests. Accept, decline, or cancel one. Only accepted friends can see your Crew status message. Players in your shared server can see your player name, car, and in-game address.
  3. Find their home. Select a friend's apartment or map button, then choose Set Game Route. Use the M-key map to select Homes or Players, then set a GPS route. Free test drives are available before the briefing.

Your first online visit assigns a permanent home and unit number. That address follows you between servers. Open My Home to install three tiers of improvements. Your first 120 home credits cover Garden Retreat. Finish neighborhood delivery jobs to earn Creative Loft and Penthouse Studio. These changes appear inside your apartment and save to your signed-in account. Removing a Crew friend stops sharing your private status message with them; shared-server presence remains visible while you are in the same server.

SHARED NEIGHBORHOODS

Join the same numbered neighborhood as a friend to see them driving or walking. Open your home from Neighborhood → Friends to welcome accepted friends into the same apartment or garage. Servers hold up to 16 players. Open Online → Jobs for deliveries that earn home credits. Leaving a server removes your live presence, while your home and upgrades are retained. Friends must have access to this Site. Passenger missions, police, traffic, demo collectibles, and arcade shift saves remain personal.

NEW / NEIGHBORHOODS

A CITY YOU LIVE IN.

Press N for Neighborhoods, or use the on-screen button. Join the same numbered server with a friend first. Servers hold up to 16 players and sync their positions approximately once per second.

WALK & VISIT TOGETHER

Stop your car and press F to get out. Walk with WASD, arrows, floor clicks, or touch controls. Return within seven meters of your parked car and press F to drive again. Open Friends → Open to friends, then let an accepted friend choose Visit home or Garage. You see each other walking in the same room. Nearby chat is scoped to the city or the room you are visiting. Wave, celebrate, or unlock a dance. Mute players or report messages from the chat panel. Closing your home or removing a friendship ends access.

YOUR FIRST COOPERATIVE JOB

  1. Open City jobs and form a Moving day crew. A second player joins from the same board.
  2. Follow the route to Last Exit. Both players must be outside at the marked stop; the host starts the job.
  3. Travel to Market Apartments in your own cars or on foot. Everyone checks in together.
  4. Each member collects 120 home credits, courier reputation, and a first-delivery table.
  5. Return home. Open My home, select the table, choose a free floor tile, and save the room. Your visitor sees the saved placement too.

Coast convoy and The clean getaway add longer shared routes. A crew has two to four members; disconnected members must reconnect before a checkpoint. Leaving an active job cancels it. Crew jobs expire after 30 minutes.

DECORATE & PROGRESS

Home credits buy furniture, wall finishes, car parts, and emotes. Place or rotate up to 12 different furnishings. Blocked tiles protect your existing furniture and walking routes. Home upgrades progress from a starter apartment to Garden Retreat, Creative Loft, and Penthouse Studio. The last upgrade opens a furnished sunroom you can walk into and decorate.

Mina’s courier work, Rae’s mechanic checklist, and Theo’s timed driving trial earn reputation. Each 100 XP advances a rank, up to rank four. Rank two unlocks longer career jobs, a collector shelf, an aero kit, or underglow. Car styling includes paint, wheels, upholstery, a street kit, and a custom eight-character plate. Use Photo to hide the interface and save a crew picture.

THIS WEEK IN THE CITY

The featured delivery route and event theme rotate every Monday at 00:00 UTC. Complete three city or cooperative jobs during that week to claim 180 home credits and a display trophy. Central Plaza is the car-meet spot. Weekly rewards can be claimed once per account per week.

TESTNET WORKSHOP

Open the testnet setup screen. Connect a browser wallet, switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet (46630), and get test ETH from the linked official faucet. Your wallet deploys the tGETAWAY test token and its fixed-price shop in two transactions. The server checks their deployed code before enabling the shop. You can instead import a friend’s shop address.

Link your wallet by signing the displayed message. Claim 25,000 free tGETAWAY once per address per day, then review an exact item cost before approving and burning. Confirmed burns need two testnet blocks. The game verifies the contract, wallet, item, amount, receipt, and ownership before granting rewards. The recovery form can safely verify a previous burn without charging again. This test deployment is separate from the planned Pons launch.

SAVED TO YOUR ACCOUNT

Neighborhood inventory, home credits, furniture placement, career XP, shared-job rewards, and weekly progress save on the server. Checkpoints validate crew membership, reported location, order, and travel time. Movement remains client-controlled. Traffic, police, and arcade passenger shifts run separately for each player. Site access is still required to play with friends.

07

SAVING PROGRESS

Your move-in, first-chapter jobs, housewarming unlock, and saved home/car designs follow your signed-in account. Apartment position, arcade credits, unlocked cars, equipped skins and driver, demo collection balance, best run, and preferences save in this browser on this device.

An unfinished shift also saves: your car, passengers, remaining time, wanted level, and unbanked haul. Progress saves every three seconds during play and when you leave the page. For an immediate save, open the driving pause menu and choose Save & return home, or use the bedside marker in your apartment.

After collecting your keys, you start at home when you reopen the game. An unfinished welcome walk restarts outside with Jules. Use the door or Resume saved shift to continue. The timer stays paused at home. Saving a shift does not bank its haul; you must still bring it to Last Exit. Finishing or restarting replaces that saved shift.

Use the same browser to keep playing with your saved profile. Clearing site data or using a different browser or device won’t carry that progress over. Private browsing may not retain your save.

08

CURRENT BUILD

GETAWAY includes the welcome tutorial, three first-chapter missions, 13 city districts, six detailed cars with free test drives, shared walking, live apartment and garage visits, chat and emotes, cooperative jobs, furniture placement, a walkable home expansion, three careers, car styling, photo mode, rotating weekly deliveries, daily errands, craftable home furnishings, and Last Hand’s shared free-play blackjack lounge.

Robinhood Chain testnet setup and verified collectible burns are available in the workshop. A connected wallet with test ETH must deploy the contracts or import a verified shop before using them. Mainnet burns and real-money rewards remain disabled.
